note: Round-23 parser fixes (vespera_macro): a path parameter whose name contains an asterisk (braces such as {x*y} or {**rest}) is rejected with a span instead of panicking when the router is built; a nested alias position (Result argument or tuple element) resolves in the scope of the alias that produced it; a user type named Body, Bytes or BytesMut is no longer documented as a raw binary request body; the crate-wide alias scan accepts any spacing after the type keyword; an Entity path through self, super or crate names no component; the response view of a Serialize struct ignores the try_from_multipart rename_all rule; a codec module matches the whole table path (the vespera re-export prefix aside), so a crate-local serde_bytes module stays unknown; an Option anywhere in a string codec type (Box<Option<String>>) makes the documented string nullable; the deserialize-side unknown-codec compile error is documented; test and comment corrections.
